analysis.purpose: cmdGaps implements the `crib gaps` CLI command. It opens the verb/index store and prints a JSON report of analysis readiness gaps, including spec-only callables and unresolved call sites, with optional filters for extracted-only symbols and built-in call sites.
responsibilities: Open the verb/index store via openVerbs
Return NOT_INDEXED if the store cannot be opened
Call verbs.gaps with optional --extracted-only and --include-builtins flags
Print the gaps report as formatted JSON to stdout
Close the index store before returning

businessRules.rule: --extracted-only filters to symbols with extracted bodies
businessRules.rationale: The flag is passed through to verbs.gaps only when args.includes('--extracted-only') is true
The flag is passed through to verbs.gaps only when args.includes('--include-builtins') is true

sideEffects: Opens and closes the index store
Writes the formatted gaps report to process.stdout
invariants: The index store is closed before the function returns
Gaps report is always printed as pretty-printed JSON
preconditions: The crib index must be openable
postconditions: Either the gaps report is printed or NOT_INDEXED is returned
